title: Restore an Operational Sanctuary Habitat and Offline Capabilities Without Cloud Access
target_platform: Local deterministic bootstrap runner; air-gapped network namespace; operating-sanctuary-guardian; forge_llm.py
hypothesis: From a sealed, locally available recovery package, a clean environment with external networking denied will: (a) restore >= 95% of a fixed 40-task capability suite; (b) complete restoration within 30 minutes; (c) preserve 100% of selected evidence artifacts byte-for-byte; (d) make zero attempted external network connections during restoration and evaluation; and (e) include at least 10 tasks requiring local MLX model execution.
falsification_criteria: Any threshold missed falsifies the hypothesis. A reconstruction that works only because it accesses undeclared host caches or environmental secrets fails. Same-machine recovery does not establish cross-hardware portability.
experiment: Compare a git checkout alone versus a declared sealed recovery package containing required weights, dependencies, procedures, and integrity metadata. Run 3 clean restores on declared hardware target using isolated homes and controlled dependency paths. Test missing and corrupted artifacts.

model_routing.frontier_escalation_condition: Frontier models are limited to authoring recovery harness specifications (ceiling 100k dev tokens, 8 local hours).
